article.story: FAIRFIELD, Conn. -- — Declan Wucherpfennig scored 21 points as Fairfield beat Saint Joseph’s (Brooklyn) 93-62 on Wednesday. Wucherpfennig also contributed 14 rebounds for the Stags (3-2). Cole Edelen finished 5 of 12 from 3-point range to add 15 points. Halon Rawlins shot 6 for 9 (0 for 3 from 3-point range) and 2 of 3 from the free-throw line to finish with 14 points. Maven Cummings finished with 17 points and six rebounds for the Bears. Saint Joseph’s (Brooklyn) also got 12 points, four assists and four steals from Justin Munson. Colin Mills also had 10 points and two steals. Up next Fairfield plays LIU on the road on Sunday, and Saint Joseph’s (Brooklyn) visits Yale on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
